shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in profile
dense field of script-like signs or inscription
justification: Both are low-relief carvings combining human figures shown in strict profile with dense fields of writing-like signs, and both include small circular/rosette motifs, which is a moderately specific shared convention. But A is a long horizontal frieze of repeated floral rosettes and a text band with only fragmentary bodies and a gripping hand, whereas B is a self-contained round-topped panel showing a seated figure facing standing adorants beneath a winged disc and offering stand — a specific cult scene absent from A.
